Run General Cohort Analysis

Source: R/run_general_cohort.R
run_general_cohort.Rd

Standalone orchestrator for Line 1.3 cohort composition and performance analysis. Parallel to run_general_trend_analysis() (Line 1) and run_anomaly_analysis() (Line 4). Runs run_cohort_analysis(), saves results to RDS, and optionally renders the Quarto report.

Usage

run_general_cohort(
  student_results_long,
  assessment_spec,
  output_dir,
  report_years = NULL,
  min_n = 10,
  render_report = TRUE,
  open_report = FALSE
)

Arguments

student_results_long

A standardized long-format student results data frame (see data contract in CLAUDE.md §6). Must have already been processed by standardize_student_results().

assessment_spec

Named list describing the assessment program. Set attr(assessment_spec, "spec_file") to the absolute path of the spec file so it can be sourced inside the QMD.

output_dir

Character. Directory where the RDS and rendered report will be copied after rendering.

report_years

Integer vector. Years to include in the analysis. If NULL (default), all years present in student_results_long are used. Always filter after standardize_student_results().

min_n

Integer. Minimum cell size for small-n suppression. Default 10.

render_report

Logical. If TRUE (default), renders the Quarto report to both docx and html.

open_report

Logical. If TRUE, opens the rendered html in a browser after rendering. Default FALSE.

Value

The cohort results list, returned invisibly.

Details

Run the General Cohort Analysis (Line 1.3)

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
source(system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR"))
attr(assessment_spec, "spec_file") <-
  system.file("specs/00_DEMO_Assessment_Spec.R", package = "ReportR")
cohort_results <- run_general_cohort(
  student_results_long = demo_data,
  assessment_spec      = assessment_spec,
  output_dir           = tempdir(),
  render_report        = FALSE
)
} # }
